newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Coelce started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coelce started as buy.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said it is initiating coverage of Brazilian electrical distributor Coelce SA, which serves the northern state of Ceara, with a buy recommendation.
-- The brokerage firm said Coelce registered sales growth of 11.1 percent in 1995 and 9.7 percent in the first half of 1996.
-- Coelce was listed on the Sao Paulo stock exchange just 10 months ago.

-- "With 1996 estimated sales of 378 million reais, a market cap of just $133.5 million and net debt of $92.3 million, Coelce is trading at a trailing FV/GWh sold ratio of $61 vs Cerj's $152," Fleming said.
-- Moreover, with a partial privatization set for 1997, Coelce could duplicate the sharp rise in valuation seen in Cerj and CPFL, it said.
-- Coelce preferred was unchanged at 0.93 reais at 1413 local/1713 gmt on the Sao Paulo stock market.
